content:
# Watch update
It's been four months to the day since I started wearing the Sekonda Hybrid watch and, apart from the initial setup period, it's just been put on its fourth charge. That's right, I'm still only having to charge it once a month, irrespective of how much I use it or how many notifications I get.

I originally said I'd be happy charging it once a week, but this is beyond my wildest expectations.

Consider me extremely happy with it.
